# Enterprise Travel Policy Document Version 1.0

This corporate policy outlines official guidelines and rules for employee travel expenses.
Employees must submit all hotel and flight receipts within thirty business days of trip conclusion.
Daily meal allowances are strictly limited to seventy-five dollars per calendar day across domestic locations.
Prior approval from the direct department manager is required for all international flight bookings.
Failure to follow these documentation guidelines may result in denied reimbursement claims.
